title: Attach a cosign SBOM attestation to the signed image digest
description: In the same build-push job of .github/workflows/docker-publish.yml, after the sign step from task 1, export the SBOM that buildx already generates (sbom: true) for the pushed digest, for example with docker buildx imagetools inspect <repo>@<digest> --format '{{ json .SBOM }}' written to the runner temp directory. Then run cosign attest --yes --type spdxjson --predicate <file> <repo>@<digest> with keyless OIDC. Keep provenance: mode=max and sbom: true unchanged. Write predicate files only to $RUNNER_TEMP and never commit them. The same action-pinning and no-secret constraints as task 1 apply.
acceptanceCriteria: grep -n 'cosign attest' .github/workflows/docker-publish.yml returns a step that attests the @sha256 digest with --type spdxjson (or cyclonedx)

For the image from the latest prerelease run, cosign verify-attestation --type spdxjson <repo>@<digest> --certificate-identity-regexp '^https://github.com/OnFinance/mongodb-mcp-server/' --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com exits 0 and prints an SBOM predicate listing the mongodb-mcp-server package

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-cicd-env on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server. Expected: the pipeline observation records a cosign attest step bound to the pushed digest, and no CICD-SIGN-01 result for .github/workflows/docker-publish.yml.

rootCause.description: The SBOM and provenance produced by buildx sit in the image index unsigned. No cosign attest step binds them to a verifiable signer identity, so a consumer cannot tell whether they came from the release pipeline.
